products.title: Special Order (For Past Designs)
products.body_html:
Special orders are available for past designs at a 20 piece minimum per design.   Due to overwhelming demand, lead time with our current production schedule will run around 10-12 weeks for fulfillment. 

Please indicate which design you would like to purchase in the special instruction field at order checkout.   If nothing is indicated we will reach out to you directly to confirm.

If you need more than 20 pieces (1 order), please contact us directly. 

*This offering only applies to individual designs (not mixed sets), mixed sets from limited collections/series are composed of 10+ individual designs.
